newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Turnover on softer Tunis bourse picks up.
newsitem.headline: Turnover on softer Tunis bourse picks up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed down by 0.22 percent in bigger volume, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 502.00 points from 503.12 points on Friday.

Total volume was 2.67 million dinars against 1.61 million dinars over the previous session. Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 2.2 million dinars and the turnover on the first market 356,861 dinars.
Banque de Tunisie fell 1.1 dinar to 78 dinars. Arab Tunisian Bank slid one dinar to 33.
Chemical firm Al-Kimia was down 0.64 dinar to 49.3 dinars. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF edged lower 0.28 dinar to 18.72. Chemical firm Idustries Chimiques du Fluor declined 0.22 dinar to 55.8 dinars.
Bucking the weaker trend were Banque de Tunisie et des Emirats d'Investissement gained 0.28 dinar to 23.28 dinars. Amen Bank Rose 0.12 dinar to 36.12 dinars.
